correctness.rationale: For fixed target and other two measures, linearity and c_k->0 reduce each marginal to cap-saturated masses (alpha,alpha,1-2alpha). The elementary additive representation ceilings N(2,2,2)<=3, N(3,2,2)<=4, N(3,3,2)<=5, N(3,3,3)<=7 give the uniform bound in the <=6 regime, while attaining N=7 rigidly forces three aligned arithmetic progressions. Independently enumerated the 27 choices of light position and recovered six exact cubic profiles, all below 3+2t+2t² for t=(1-2alpha)/alpha in [0,1]. Comparing with 3+3t gives the phase boundary t=1/2 or alpha=2/5; LLR vs LLL explicit mass configurations attain the two envelopes. Independent finite grid of three-element supports and rational tests confirmed the arithmetic; proof of arbitrary integer supports is not inferred from that grid.
residual_risks: The extremal upper bound uses a finite additive-combinatorial rigidity argument; it is not derived from sampling three-point laws alone.
